Metadata.Goal: Normalize common low-risk multiline bash command shapes before permission rule evaluation.
Metadata.Description: Handle top-level newline segments and Python stdin heredoc forms without escalating to unsupported syntax approval.

TaskSpace.name: update-bash-command-normalization
TaskSpace.Description: Normalize safely parseable bash command forms.

TaskGroup.name: Normalization tests
TaskGroup.Description: Add failing tests for newline command segmentation and Python stdin heredoc forms.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Tests cover newline-separated readonly commands and Python heredoc without explicit dash.

Task.name: Add parser normalization tests
Task.Description: Extend local permission evaluator tests with real approval-noise command shapes.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Newline-separated read commands normalize to separate allowed segments.
Python stdin heredoc without explicit dash normalizes to `python3 -`.

TaskGroup.name: Normalization implementation
TaskGroup.Description: Implement conservative multiline and heredoc normalization.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Existing unsupported dangerous syntax tests still pass.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Top-level newline commands are parsed through existing segment rules.
Unsupported multiline shell forms continue to require approval or throw in direct parser tests.

Task.name: Run targeted test
Task.Description: Run the local permission evaluator test file and record results.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Targeted local permission evaluator tests pass.
